prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1266; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The left rear quarter panel and rear door show crumpling consistent with a side impact at an intersection, with the damage pattern lining up well with the account given. Structural measurements taken at the shop show the frame is within tolerance, and nothing in the inspection points to older damage on this vehicle. The labor hours requested fit the scope of the work needed, and the parts list reflects what the repair requires. The billing history submitted by the shop shows no repeated charges. Recommended plan: replace the rear door and quarter panel, refinish and blend adjacent panels, and recalibrate the rear sensors before release.
